visualRisks.description: Water and road colors are very similar (#143950 and #667b8a), which may cause visual confusion.
visualRisks.suggestion: Consider using more distinct colors for water and roads.

visualRisks.description: The dock color (#98734e) is quite close to the ground color (#283e35).
visualRisks.suggestion: Distinguish between dock and ground with different shades or hues.

navigationRisks.description: Route path 106-94 has a sudden change in direction, which might be confusing for players.
navigationRisks.suggestion: Smooth out the route to avoid abrupt changes in direction.

navigationRisks.description: The route includes many consecutive turns (e.g., 52 to 41, 77 to 68), which could make navigation difficult.
navigationRisks.suggestion: Reduce the number of consecutive turns or provide clearer visual cues for these transitions.
